name: Tokens of the Departed
desc: When a creature you can see dies within 30 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to open your free hand and cause a Tiny trinket to appear there, a Soul Trinket. You can have a maximum number of Soul Trinkets equal to your Proficiency Bonus. While a Soul Trinket is on your person, you have Advantage on Death Saving Throws and Constitution saving throws. You can destroy a trinket to use Wails from the Grave without expending a use, or (as a Magic action) to ask the trinket's spirit one question.
